name: Background and noise model
description: Background model (mesh / polynomial / both) with source masking, local rms map, pixel autocorrelation, blank-aperture noise law sigma_N = sigma_pix alpha N^beta for correlated (drizzled) noise, flatness check, and catalog flux/magnitude errors that use the measured law instead of sqrt(N).

params.name: model
params.label: Background model
params.help: mesh = sigma-clipped mesh (sep) with source masking; poly = one polynomial surface (smooth gradient only); mesh+poly = polynomial first, mesh on the residual (follows a gradient and local structure).

params.name: bw
params.label: Mesh size (px)
params.help: Mesh cell size of the background / rms map. Smaller follows scattered light better but eats extended sources.

params.name: fw
params.label: Mesh filter (cells)
params.help: Median filter width over mesh cells.

params.name: poly-order
params.label: Polynomial order
params.help: Total degree of the polynomial surface (poly and mesh+poly).

params.name: mask-thresh
params.label: Source mask threshold (sigma)
params.help: Pixels above this many sigma (connected, see min. area) are masked before estimating background and noise. A lower value masks noise peaks and biases the sky low.

params.name: radii
params.label: Aperture radii (px)
params.help: Radii of the blank apertures used to measure sigma_N(N) = sigma_pix alpha N^beta.

params.name: n-aper
params.label: Blank apertures per radius
params.help: Number of source-free apertures per radius (statistical error of each sigma_N is 1/sqrt(2 n) before overlap).

params.name: aperture
params.label: Catalog aperture
params.help: auto = Kron-like ellipse of the catalog (kron-fact x KRON_RADIUS x A, B) for FLUX_AUTO; fixed = circular aperture of the radius below, whose flux is also measured on the background-subtracted image (NM_FLUX_AP).

params.name: kron-fact
params.label: Kron factor
params.help: Aperture = kron-fact x KRON_RADIUS x (A, B) (SExtractor convention).

params.name: gain
params.label: Gain (e-/ADU, 0 = none)
params.help: Adds the Poisson term flux / gain to the error. 0 = sky noise only (use for background-limited faint sources or when the image is not in electrons).

params.name: correct
params.label: Write background-subtracted image
params.help: Write noisemodel_sub.fits (image - background model) to the work directory.

params.name: show-frames
params.label: Open background / rms in frames
params.help: Load the background model and rms map into new frames after the run.

params.name: sky-annulus
params.label: Local sky annulus R_in,R_out (px)
params.help: Empty = off. With an annulus (e.g. 12,18) the unified error model measures the noise of blank apertures after local-sky subtraction and adds NM_SKYERR (sky-estimation error) and NM_FLUXERR_LOC (error of the local-sky-subtracted aperture flux, includes the pixel correlation).

params.name: psf
params.label: PSF for neighbour contamination (json / FITS)
params.help: PSF model json (PSF plugin) or FITS stamp. With a sky annulus: NM_CONTAM = flux the wings of the other catalogue sources put into each aperture (net of the annulus sky, counts, a bias to subtract) and NM_FLUXERR_TOT = NM_FLUXERR_LOC plus the contamination uncertainty. Neighbours are treated as point sources with FLUX_AUTO.
